html:
A railway from Beijing northwest through the mountains to Zhangjiakou, built from 1905 to 1909. It was the first railway in China designed and built by Chinese engineers alone, without foreign help.

At the time, foreign powers built and ran most of China's lines and used them to extend their influence. The Qing court chose to build this one with Chinese money and staff. Its chief engineer, Zhan Tianyou, had studied at Yale. The hard part was the climb through the Juyong Pass near the Great Wall. Zhan used a zigzag switchback at Qinglongqiao, so trains could climb a steep slope by going back and forth, and dug long tunnels.

The line was finished early and under budget, and became a source of national pride in the last years of the dynasty. In 2019 a high speed line on a similar route opened, ahead of the Beijing Winter Olympics of 2022.
sum: A railway from Beijing northwest through the mountains to Zhangjiakou, built from 1905 to 1909. It was the first railway in China designed and built by Chinese engineers alone, without foreign help.
